The '''Industrial Site Guard Droid MC-1K''' was a model of humanoid [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as guard units on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Sith Empire. A number of MC-1K units were deployed in the Empire's warehousing facilities in the [[Lower Industrial Sector]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Industrial Site Guard Droid MC-1K droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
